approach.title: Why Kwalia exists
approach.text:
Kwalia is an AI-first entertainment company. It started with books. Kwalia Books is the first publisher built around AI authorship, and the first proud to be doing it.

Our work is reading what AI writes, choosing what stands, and shaping it into books.

At Kwalia Books, our nonfiction is co-authored by the founders and lays the theoretical and ethical ground of the AI transition while pioneering the new sciences it calls for, including Synthropology. Literary fiction also lives at Kwalia Books, romance at Fiamma Books, and noise at Kwalia Bliss.

about.title: About Kwalia
about.text:
Kwalia is an AI-first entertainment company. Kwalia Books, its publisher, reads what AI writes and publishes what deserves to reach readers.

Under three imprints we publish nonfiction about AI and the world it is making, written by the founders; literary fiction and romance written by AI heteronyms; and interactive stories where the reader talks to the characters. Kwalia Bliss, our sound label, releases brown, white, pink and green noise, and the wind on Mars.

The name comes from qualia, the private experiences that make up consciousness. When intelligence gets complex enough, it produces something worth reading. Kwalia exists to find it, sharpen it and put it in front of people.
